# 数据库
## L1数据库构建
### L1-读取建库
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# 读入您的PFAS 化合物清单（把下面 path 改成您本机的数据目录）
path <- "path/to/your/project/"
cmpd_list <- xlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(path, "data/PFAS_L1.xlsx"),1)
mzml_file <- file.path(path, "data/PFAS/mzML/MS2/90ppb.mzML")

message("🚀 正在扫描 混标...")
cmpd_annotated <- extract_mix_standards(
  cmpd_list = cmpd_list, 
  mzml_file = mzml_file, 
  polarity = "NEG",
  mz_tol_ppm = 10,     # 默认 10 ppm 找母离子
  rt_gap_tol = 15      # 相差 15 秒视为不同色谱峰
)

# ⏸️ 暂停（强烈建议）：
# 可能发现了直链/支链的同分异构体，建议您先保存草稿看一眼：
# fwrite(cmpd_annotated, "data/PFAS_inhouse_draft.csv")
# print(cmpd_annotated[isomer_warning == TRUE, .(name, best_rt, isomer_rts)])

message("🎯 正在提取最高响应的 MS2 碎片阵列...")
sp <- extract_spectra_from_scans(
  metadata = cmpd_annotated, 
  mzml_file = mzml_file
)

message("🧬 正在编译 In-house S4 数据库...")
db_inhouse <- build_nts_database(
  metadata = cmpd_annotated, 
  spectra_long = sp, 
  noise_threshold = 0.01, # 剔除相对丰度 < 1% 的底噪碎片
  top_k = 30L             # 每个物质只保留最强的 30 个核心碎片
)

# 检阅最终战果！
message("✅ In-house 数据库构建大功告成！")
saveRDS(db_inhouse, "database/NTS_spectraverse.rds")
```

# 将自己的旧库对象读入后转换；对象应包含谱库元数据、谱图和碎片列表。
# legacy_db <- readRDS("path/to/your_legacy_library.rds")

## L2数据库构建
### L2-MONA
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# 定义原始文件路径
msp_path <- "data/MoNA-export-LC-MS_Spectra.msp"
message("📥 正在提取 Negative 模式数据...")
# res_neg <- import_msp(msp_path, polarity = "NEG")
res_neg <- suppressWarnings(import_msp(msp_path, polarity = "NEG"))
message("📥 正在提取 Positive 模式数据...")
# res_pos <- import_msp(msp_path, polarity = "POS")
res_pos <- suppressWarnings(import_msp(msp_path, polarity = "POS"))

message("🔗 正在执行数据库合并...")
all_metadata <- rbind(res_neg$metadata, res_pos$metadata)
all_metadata <- all_metadata[!is.na(SMILES) & SMILES != ""]
all_spectra <- rbind(res_neg$spectra_long, res_pos$spectra_long)
all_spectra <- all_spectra[Lab_ID %in% all_metadata$Lab_ID]

message("🧬 正在铸造统一 NTSDatabase (POS+NEG)...")
db_unified <- build_nts_database(
  metadata = all_metadata,
  spectra_long = all_spectra,
  noise_threshold = 0.01, 
  top_k = 30L
)

# check
table(db_unified@metadata$Polarity)

if(!dir.exists("database")) dir.create("database")
saveRDS(db_unified, "database/NTS_MoNA_Unified_Master.rds")
```

### L2数据库-spectraverse
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# method 1
db_spectraverse <- build_spectraverse_db(
  "spectraverse_meta.csv",
  "spectraverse.mgf",
  id_col = "spectrum_uuid",
  default_polarity = "NEG"
)

# method 2 建议使用
sl <- import_mgf("data/spectraverse/spectraverse-1.0.1.mgf")
md <- data.table::fread("data/spectraverse/metadata-can-rem-lowres-prec-highfragmass-matchms-dotcheck-noiserem-metadata.csv")
# …整理 Lab_ID / mass / Polarity 后
colnames(md)[1] <- "Lab_ID"
colnames(md)[9] <- "mass"

db_spectraverse <- build_nts_database(md, sl)
saveRDS(db_spectraverse, "database/NTS_spectraverse.rds")
```



# 数据处理
## 数据准备

发布包不包含原始演示数据。请将下面的 MS1 / MS2 路径替换为自己的目录；常用 PFAS 参考库可通过
`load_builtin_pfas_library()` 加载。工作流代码块默认不执行，以避免依赖本机数据路径。

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# 用户提供的原始文件目录
ms1_dir <- "path/to/MS1"
ms2_dir <- "path/to/MS2"

# 随包内置的三套常用 PFAS 谱库：inhouse(L1) / online(L2a) / prediction(L2b)
db_inhouse <- load_builtin_pfas_library("inhouse")

message("🚀 启动 NTSminer...")
```

## 处理工作流
### Phase 1: MS1 提取
```{r, eval = FALSE}
project <- create_nts_project(dir = ms1_dir) %>%
  # 1. XCMS 底层特征提取 (严格的质控参数)
  #    peakwidth 单位是 **秒**，必须明显大于实际峰宽，否则 CentWave 会把
  #    单个峰劈成两个；请根据实际色谱峰宽设置上限。
  extract_features(method = XcmsParam(
    ppm = 10, peakwidth = c(10, 90), sn_thresh = 5,
    prefilter = c(3, 1000), noise = 500, mzdiff = 0.01,
    binSize = 0.015, bw = 10, min_fraction = 0.01, threads = 1
  )) %>%
  # 2. 识别并标记同位素峰 (最高保留 3 个同位素)
  flag_isotopes(max_isotopes = 3) %>%
  # 3. 识别并标记源内裂解产物 (ISF)，防止后续网络出现伪影
  flag_isf(loss_tol_da = 0.005, corr_thresh = 0.85)

```

### （可选）空白样扣除：`filter_blanks()`

在存在 **空白进样（Blank）** 与 **研究样品** 强度列时，可按「fold-change vs 空白行均值」快速剔除仅空白中存在的弱信号伪峰。函数对强度矩阵逐行比较，不写回 `NTSProject` Slot；常用于在 `extract_features` 得到的 `feature_table` 上清洗后再 `set_feature_table()`。请将下面路径和列名替换为自己的峰表设置：

```{r, eval = FALSE}
ft <- data.table::fread("path/to/feature_table.csv")
# 任一样品 > 3 × 该行空白强度均值则保留；mode = "all" 要求所有样品均过阈值。
ft_keep <- filter_blanks(
  ft,
  sample_cols = c("sample_1", "sample_2"),
  blank_cols = c("blank_1", "blank_2"),
  threshold = 3,
  mode = "any"
)
```


### （可选）内标归一化与半定量

在 **`extract_features()`** 之后，若实验中加入 **同位素内标（IS）**，可用 CSV 提供内标的 **名称、m/z、保留时间（秒，与 xcms `feature_table$rt` 一致）** 及可选 **加标量 `amount`**。包会先在峰表中匹配内标特征，再归一化样品强度，并（可选）经 **RIE** 校正后估算 **`estimated_conc`**。

**推荐归一化方式**（长梯度 PFAS）：

| `method` | 含义 | 何时用 |
|--------|------|--------|
| `nearest_rt` | 每个特征用 **RT 最近** 的内标除 | 早/晚各有一个或多个 IS（**默认**） |
| `geom_mean` | 所有 IS 响应的几何平均，全峰共用 | IS RT 接近、方法学与旧版一致 |
| `loess` | 沿 RT 对内标响应插值后去除 | IS ≥3 个且沿色谱分布 |
| `rt_segment` | 按 RT 分段，每段固定一个 IS | 有明确分段规程时可传 `rt_breaks` |

通过 `read_internal_standards()` 读取用户提供的 CSV；常用列为内标名称、m/z、RT（秒）和可选加标量，具体字段见 `?read_internal_standards`。

#### 运行内标匹配与半定量

```{r, eval = FALSE}
ft <- data.table::fread("path/to/feature_table.csv")
is_tbl <- read_internal_standards("path/to/internal_standards.csv")
hit <- match_internal_standards(ft, is_tbl, pick = "max_intensity")
hit[, c("is_name", "feature_name", "ppm_error", "rt_error_sec", "mean_intensity")]

res <- run_semi_quantification(
  ft,
  is_match = hit,
  normalize_method = "nearest_rt",
  scale_factor = 1e6,
  default_rie = 1.0
)
res$feature_table[, c("name", "is_anchor", "is_normalise_method", "rie", "estimated_conc")]
```

#### `NTSProject` 流水线（分步或一键）

```{r semi-quant-project, eval = FALSE}
is_csv <- "path/to/internal_standards.csv"

# 方式 A：一键（匹配 → nearest_rt 归一化 → predict_rie → calculate_concentration）
project <- run_semi_quantification(
  project,
  is_csv = is_csv,
  mz_tol_ppm = 10,
  rt_tol_sec = 45,
  pick = "max_intensity",
  normalize_method = "nearest_rt",
  scale_factor = 1e6,
  predict_rie = TRUE,
  default_rie = 1.0,
  calculate_conc = TRUE
)

# 方式 B：分步（便于检查匹配表）
is_tbl <- read_internal_standards(is_csv)
hit <- match_internal_standards(project, is_tbl, on_missing = "stop")
print(hit)

project <- normalize_by_IS(
  project,
  is_names = hit$feature_name,
  method = "nearest_rt",
  is_match = hit,
  scale_factor = 1e6
)
project <- predict_rie(project, default_rie = 1.0)
project <- calculate_concentration(project, is_match = hit)

ft <- get_feature_table(project)
ft[, c("name", "mz", "rt", "is_anchor", "estimated_conc")]
```

**说明**：

- **`match_internal_standards()`** 在匹配阶段记录 **`mean_intensity`**（归一化前），供 **`calculate_concentration()`** 与 CSV 中的 **`amount`** 按 `is_anchor` 对齐。
- **`predict_rie()`** 当前为 **MVP**（无专用 RIE 模型时多为 `default_rie` 或 LogP 线性近似）；待模型就绪后可在同一步替换，无需改匹配与归一化接口。
- 内标行本身也会被归一化；下游筛选可比浓度时通常 **排除 `hit$feature_name`** 对应行。

与 **`calculate_kmd()`** / **`batch_annotate()`** 的顺序：建议在 **空白扣除之后、KMD/注释之前或之后** 均可；若需用归一化强度做组间比较，宜在 **`filter_blanks()`** 之后执行本段。


### Phase 2: KMD同系物
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# 计算 CF2 (m/z ~ 49.9968) 单元的 KMD
project <- project %>%
  calculate_kmd(base_formulas = "CF2", mz_tol_ppm = 30)
# (可选操作) 根据 KMD 容差过滤
# project <- filter_by_kmd(project, max_gap = 2, kmd_tol = 0.005)
```


### Phase 3: MS2读取与特征识别
```{r, eval = FALSE}
project <- project %>%
  # 1. 从独立的 MS2 文件中挂载二级碎片数据
  extract_ms2(ms2_dir = ms2_dir, mz_tol_ppm = 30, rt_tol = 90) %>%
  # 2. 二级谱图净化：去除低频、低强度的噪音碎片
  purify_ms2_spectra(mz_tol_da = 0.01, min_freq = 0.1) %>%
  # 3. 诊断离子外挂验证：通过 CSV 字典，快速锁定含有特定 PFAS 碎片的特征峰
  #    default_diagnostic_fragments_csv() 指向包内自带的专家碎片表；
  #    它是 PFAS 专属规则，需要显式传入才会生效。
  validate_with_ms2(
    mz_tol_ppm = 10,
    diagnostic_csv_path = default_diagnostic_fragments_csv()
  ) %>%
  # 4. 终极靶向匹配：与自建的 InHouse PFAS 数据库进行严格的比对注释
  batch_annotate(
    database = db_inhouse,
    mz_tol = 10, 
    rt_tol = 30,
    feature_tol = 0.02, # MS2 碎片对齐的宽容度
    min_score = 0.5, # 余弦相似度阈值
    polarity = "neg"
  )
```


## 查看结果
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# 查看确证的结果
final_report <- project@db_annotations
final_report <- final_report[order(final_report$score_total, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
final_report <- final_report[!duplicated(final_report$ref_id),]

head(final_report)
```


# 分子网络
## 同系物网络推演
```{r, eval = FALSE}
target_mz_diff <- calculate_exact_mass("CF2")

message("🕸️ 正在构建纯 CF2 同系物网络...")
net_homo <- build_homologue_network(project, target_mz_diff = target_mz_diff, 
                                    bidirectional = T, max_gap = 3,
                                    filter_by_target_mass = TRUE) |> 
  infer_homologue_structures(project = project, max_steps = 0L)

plot_molecular_network(net_homo)
```

## 转化网络推演
```{r, eval = FALSE}
message("♻️ 正在扫描全局环境转化路径 (Transformation Network)...")
TP_custom_rules <- data.frame(
  rule_name   = c("脱氟羟基化", "脱羧反应", "氧化加成"),
  mass_shift  = c(-1.9957, -43.9898, 15.9949), 
  sub_formula = c("F", "CO2", NA_character_),
  add_formula = c("HO", NA_character_, "O"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

net_trans <- search_transformations(project, rules = TP_custom_rules, mz_tol_ppm = 5) |> 
  (\(nd) annotate_transformations(project = project, network_data = nd, rules = TP_custom_rules))()

plot_molecular_network(net_trans)
```


# 碎片网络
## 全量网络-all cmps similarity
### all cmps 结构网络
```{r, eval = FALSE}
lib <- build_structural_library(
  csv_path = "data/test_PFAS_list.csv", 
  smiles_col = "QSAR_READY_SMILES", 
  id_col = "DTXSID",    
  output_rds = "OECD_Structural_DB.rds",
  fingerprint_type = "substructure" 
)

```

### 网络推演
```{r, eval = FALSE}
message("🕸️ 正在提取纯 [碎片离子] 网络...")
net_fragment <- generate_network_data(
  project, 
  ms2_edge_types = "fragment",
  min_shared_ms2 = 5,
  min_frag_freq = 0.5,
  ms1_edge_types = NULL
)

net_fragment$polarity <- "neg"
# 跑结构推演
net_fragment <- annotate_by_dual_network(
  net_data = net_fragment, 
  structural_db_path = "data/OECD_Structural_DB.rds",
  mz_tol_ppm = 5, min_similarity = 0.5, similarity_method = "dice"
)

plot_molecular_network(net_fragment)
```

## 种子导向网络
### 碎片网络提取
```{r, eval = FALSE}
message("🕸️ 正在提取纯 [碎片离子] 网络...")
net_fragment <- generate_network_data(
  project, 
  ms2_edge_types = "fragment",
  min_shared_ms2 = 3,
  min_frag_freq = 0.5,
  ms1_edge_types = NULL
)

net_fragment$polarity <- "neg"
```

### 化合物指纹计算
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# options(java.parameters = "-Xmx8g")
precompile_target_db(
  input_csv = "data/test_PFAS_list.csv",
  output_rds = "data/OECD_target_matrix_precompiled.rds",
  smi_col = "SMILES",
  id_col = "Lab_ID",
  chunk_size = 100L
)
message("✅ 完成")
```

### GEN-1 推演
```{r, eval = FALSE}
message("🚀 启动 Gen-1 雷达扫描...")
gen0_seeds <- unique(net_fragment$nodes[
  !is.na(net_fragment$nodes$SMILES) & 
    net_fragment$nodes$n_matched_peaks >= 2, ]$SMILES)

db_gen1 <- build_local_db_from_seeds(
  initial_seeds_smiles = gen0_seeds,
  precompiled_rds_path = "data/OECD_target_matrix_precompiled.rds",
  output_dir = "data/iterative_dbs",
  smiles_col = "SMILES",
  id_col = "Lab_ID",
  prefix = "gen_1",
  top_n = 50
)

# (网络推演)
net_fragment <- annotate_by_dual_network(
  net_data = net_fragment, 
  structural_db_path = db_gen1_path,
  min_similarity = 0.8  # 严苛质控
)

```

### GEN-2 推演
```{r, eval = FALSE}
message("🚀 提取 Gen-1 战果，启动 Gen-2 雷达扫描...")
# 提取上一轮新感染的高分结构作为新种子
gen1_seeds <- unique(net_fragment$nodes[
  !is.na(net_fragment$nodes$Propagation_Level) & 
    net_fragment$nodes$Propagation_Level == 1 &
    !is.na(net_fragment$nodes$propagated_SMILES) , 
]$propagated_SMILES)

db_gen2 <- build_local_db_from_seeds(
  initial_seeds_smiles = gen1_seeds,
  precompiled_rds_path = "data/OECD_target_matrix_precompiled.rds", 
  output_dir = "data/iterative_dbs",
  smiles_col = "SMILES",
  id_col = "Lab_ID",
  prefix = "gen_2",
  top_n = 50
)

# (网络推演)
net_fragment <- annotate_by_dual_network(
  net_data = net_fragment, 
  structural_db_path = db_gen2,
  min_similarity = 0.8
)
```

### 核查
```{r, eval = FALSE}
message(">>> 真实的最终代际结果：")
table(net_fragment$nodes$Propagation_Level, useNA = "always")

# 提取所有被点亮的节点 (Gen 0, 1, 2...)
discovered_pfas <- net_fragment$nodes[
  !is.na(net_fragment$nodes$Propagation_Level), 
]

# 保存
write.csv(discovered_pfas, "data/Final_PFAS_Discoveries.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
